question: When a new text document is created in MS - Office 2016, the default text size of the document is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11 points**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Layout Tab** allows you to change the page orientation from portrait to landscape.
 
• The insert feature allows you to create a **drop cap.**
 
• **Office 2016** was released on September 22, 2015, for Windows and July 9, 2015, for macOS. 
 
• **Applications of MS-office** are MS Word, MS Excel, MS Powerpoint, MS Outlook etc.
